summary: Mantle Reach Power LLC is a current EnCap Energy Transition Fund III-backed geothermal IPP that develops, owns and operates projects across North America. It should be created once with Mantle Reach as an alias, an undisclosed stake and no inferred entry date. EnCap's reported 2023 initial-investment year is preserved only as qualified legacy history because continuity into the 2026 geothermal LLC and Fund III vehicle is not publicly established.
